text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Jun ◇, Morning | Wind: Groovy! "Ride the 
Ripples!" 
========================================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Today is finally my debut race! The stage 
is Hanshin Racecourse. My friends traveled 
all this way to see me off on my maiden 
voyage!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
With the expected lap times taught by the 
Navigator, preparations are complete. All 
that's left is to charge ahead!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
With the crowd's energy, my dancing is 
feeling great! All right, I'll give 
everyone a dream to believe in. With a 
Make Debut full of rolling waves!
